description: Unit test implementation for hashmap data structure, including functions for insertion, retrieval, removal, iteration, and case sensitivity testing.

classes.name: test_entry
classes.description: Structure representing a hashmap entry with key and value as null-terminated strings.

methods.name: test_entry_cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for test_entry objects, supporting case-insensitive comparison.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value string from a test_entry.

methods.name: alloc_test_entry
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new test_entry with given key and value.

methods.name: get_test_entry
methods.description: Retrieves a test_entry from hashmap by key, considering case sensitivity.

methods.name: key_val_contains
methods.description: Checks if a test_entry's key and value match any in a given list, updating seen array.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up a hashmap, runs a test function, and then clears the hashmap.

methods.name: t_replace
methods.description: Tests replacing entries in the hashmap with case sensitivity consideration.

methods.name: t_get
methods.description: Tests retrieving entries from the hashmap with case sensitivity consideration.

methods.name: t_add
methods.description: Tests adding entries to the hashmap with case sensitivity consideration.

methods.name: t_remove
methods.description: Tests removing entries from the hashmap with case sensitivity consideration.

methods.name: t_iterate
methods.description: Tests iterating over entries in the hashmap with case sensitivity consideration.

methods.name: t_alloc
methods.description: Tests allocating and bulk inserting entries into the hashmap with case sensitivity consideration.
